title: Great way to see the city!
text: Great way roo see city and a nice team took good care of us. Great flexibility and communivation during the tour.
author: Y6014EPchristians

title: My Christmas present
text: The GoCar is easy to drive and very safe, so we didn’t have to worry about anything. In addition, the support team was very friendly and professional.
author: Compass24047380614

title: This is fun
text:
We saw a lot on our tour of the city. The GPS got you around town well. Even if you turned too late, it was no problem to find your way back to the route. Since you can't adjust the seats, it's a bit tight for taller people. We definitely had fun, and can only recommend this!!!
Thanks also to the friendly staff!!!
author: 249katjar

title: Super fun way of discovering Barcelona
text:
Incredible experience I would do it again with friends, couples, etc… 
Really nice way of seeing Barcelona. The only thing is thta if you are traveling with an elderly bare in mind that the space in the car is little.
author: Ana_H

title: Go car goudi 3 hour tour
text: The 3 hour go car tour was brilliant, staff were very friendly. Tour was very informative and showed all the areas of interest. Traffic within the city was busy as expected and in some cases confusing although this is not under the control of gocar. The cars themselves were well equipped with with the GPS system and loud speakers to give directions and information. All in a great service and would use again.
author: Relax30663728681

title: Self drive tour
text: Brilliant way to get close and personal to the sites and sounds of Barcelona. There are three routes to choose from and the tour is at your own pace. Excellent way to see Barcelona.
author: Jackie_B

title: Great way to experience Barcelona. Must Do!
text: Great tour. The GoCar was easy to drive and the roads were easy to navigate. We got a lot of people looking at taking pictures in the city center. Great drive around the city and then up Mount Tibidabo. There was a car park to pull into and enjoy the views of Barcelona. Would definately recommend - a fantasic way to spend a couple of hours and see the sights.
author: O5225SGmattd

title: Beautiful weather + GoCar = great experience
text: Amazing experience driving around Barcelona in Electric karts. Expect people to check you out and make pictures of you when waiting at the traffic lights! We really enjoyed the tour, everything was clear and very good explanation before heading into the hectic Barcelona traffic. The traffic was very busy on the Pg de Gracia around 12h30 which caused us to be back 30minutes late but that was not an issue at all. Really grateful for that since we were stressing a bit.
author: X2174WGnicka

title: A unique and fun way to explore Barcelona
text: This was a fantastic way to see the city and do so taking your time and taking in the sights and smells of Barcelona. It was safe and fun and highly recommended.
author: DavidSeth_K

title: Excellent customer service staff.
text: Great little car experience. Fit 2 large adults and backpacks in the trunk. GPS navigator guides & narrates the sights (with a bit of humor).  We took the beach front tour and the weather was marvelous.  Best part is the very sweet and easy-going staff who accommodate the customer wonderfully - which is a bit uncommon in Spain. Special thanks to Aymane!
author: PatrickD2484
